$description: Customer app tokens, theme v2 (2026-11-14, design/system/customer-theme-v2.md): Jivo green + Jivo gold on a warm ivory canvas, white cards. v2 no longer relies on ColorScheme.fromSeed for the roles the app paints: every colour below with a 'flutter' mapping is pinned in a customer-only theme, buildCustomerTheme() in customer_app/lib/app/theme.dart (ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: brand.seed).copyWith(...) with these exact values), so the contrast records are exact. It is built on jivo_core's JivoTheme.light() the same way rider_app/lib/app/theme.dart is; JivoTheme.light() and JivoBrandColors.seed stay unchanged, because the rider app builds on them. The seed only fills roles the app never paints (tertiary and its containers). History: v1 values came from the seed #2E7D32 (audit design/audits/2026-11-10-customer-app.md). Every value marked placeholder in $extensions.status is a design placeholder that changes when the Jivo brand kit arrives (H-19, D-06). Error, white, the veg marks and the rating star are not brand values. Dimensions are logical pixels (dp), font sizes are sp. CSS custom property for the admin panel = the token path with dots replaced by dashes, prefixed '--' (e.g. customer.color.text.primary -> --customer-color-text-primary).

seed.$description: Customer v2 seed, passed to ColorScheme.fromSeed only inside buildCustomerTheme(). It only fills roles that are not pinned (tertiary family); no widget paints it. JivoBrandColors.seed in jivo_core stays #2E7D32 for the rider app until H-19.

primary.$description: Jivo green (v2, pinned). QuantityBox fill, TextButton and OutlinedButton labels, links, selected nav icon and label, focused field border, search icon, header band end, product list rail border.

primaryDeep.$description: Deep Jivo green. App bars on every inner screen, Home header band start, cart bar, referral strip start. White text and light status-bar icons on it.

primaryContainer.$description: Mint. Pack-size pill on product cards, in-progress status chip, delivery OTP card, my ticket bubble, selected sub-category in the rail, banner fallback.

secondaryContainer.$description: = accent.goldLight. NavigationBar indicator pill, selected chips, delivery stage card, session-expired card on login.

gold.$description: Jivo gold (from the referral banner the users liked). Main CTA (FilledButton, ElevatedButton), ADD button, the View cart pill, discount badge, referral strip CTA, the bolt icon in the header. Never text or an icon on a light background (1.55:1 on white).

$extensions.flutter: CustomerColors.gold; also colorScheme.secondary (pinned; the app never paints secondary as text)

onGold.$description: Ink. Every label and icon on gold or gold-light (from price_tier_nudge_card _ink).

goldLight.$description: Offer strip gradient start (= the cart savings card start), bulk-price pill, nav indicator, selected chips.

goldDeep.$description: Offer strip gradient end (= the cart savings card end).

goldEdge.$description: 1 dp border around gold buttons so the shape reads on white and ivory (4.65:1 on white, 3.01:1 against gold).

base.$description: Warm ivory canvas instead of plain white: scaffold, inner-screen bodies, checkout bars.

card.$description: White cards on the ivory canvas: product cards, cart lines, coupon, address and order cards, bottom sheets.

high.$description: Unselected chips, dialogs, slab-table header row.

highest.$description: Skeletons, image placeholders, refund line, support bubble, out-of-stock pill, unknown status chip.

imageWell.$description: Cool mint-aqua behind product photos on cards and product detail (a fresh-water cue against the warm canvas). Decorative: no text sits directly on it.

primary.$description: Body and title text. (The rider sunlight token rider.color.text.primary is #1A1C19; both are about 16-17:1, align them when the brand kit lands.)

secondary.$description: Helper text, variant names, MRP, dates, muted lines. Nothing lighter is allowed for text that carries information.

default.$description: Text-field borders, OutlinedButton borders, and (proposed, CA-29) the 'upcoming' timeline icon and connector.

decorative.$description: Warm dividers and decoration only. Fails 3:1, so never for an icon or border that carries meaning.

fg.$description: Discount rows, FREE delivery, You save, coupon applied, delivered chip text, check icons.

tint.$description: success.fg at 10% over surface.base: free-delivery nudge, savings banner. Pin as an opaque colour so the ratio is fixed.

chipBg.$description: success.fg at 12% over surface.card (white): the Delivered status chip.

fg.$description: Store-closed banner background, rating stars, icons and 2 dp borders of warning notices.

tint.$description: Notice background for non-error attention states (proposed): pending-payment banner (CA-23), 'Can't update live' tracking line (CA-26), price-changed notice (CA-19), partial-unavailability notice (CA-27). Same value as rider.color.cod.bg.

fg.$description: Errors, 'Only 2 left', cart line issues, checkout blocker reason, Delete account.

container.$description: Ended status chips (Cancelled, Payment failed, Delivery unsuccessful), delivery-failed card, location error card.

tint.$description: danger.fg at 10% over surface.base: cart refresh-failed and cart-problems notices.

status.$description: Order status chips (labels from docs/08 §1, always text plus colour).

pendingPayment.$description: Proposed (CA-23): 'Completing payment…' is not an error, so it leaves the red error container.

outBg.$description: Proposed (CA-11) 'Out of stock' pill. The tile's text keeps full contrast; only the image is greyed.

discountBadge.$description: v2: offers are gold. Same values as accent.gold / accent.onGold.

dietMark.$description: FSSAI veg / non-veg marks. Regulatory colours, not brand. Shape carries the meaning too (CA-12: non-veg is a triangle).

star.$description: Filled stars (= warning.fg). Empty stars use text.secondary, read-only empty stars too (not the 38% disabled colour).

header.$description: brand.primaryDeep -> brand.primary, top-left to bottom-right. Home header band and the referral strip. Text on it is checked against both stops.

offer.$description: accent.goldLight -> accent.goldDeep, top-left to bottom-right. Welcome / coupon offer strip and the cart savings card (already built with these values).

shadow.$description: shadowColor for cards, the search field, cart bar and nav bar. Flutter applies the alpha from the elevation; never a blur bigger than elevation 3.

lg.$description: Product cards, banners, the Home search field, offer strips.

xl.$description: Bottom corners of the Home header band; top corners of bottom sheets.

pill.$description: Chips, pack-size and bulk pills, the View cart pill, nav indicator.

elevation.$description: Material elevation (dp). Flutter draws one cheap shadow per level; no custom blur.

flat.$description: App bars, header band, chips, strips.

raised.$description: Search field on the band, cart bar, nav bar, pressed CTA.

minTarget.$description: Every tappable thing: buttons, chips (padded), icon buttons, stepper halves, list rows.

cartBar.$description: Minimum height of the floating cart bar.

pdpActionBar.$description: Proposed (CA-13) sticky price + ADD bar on product detail, above the cart bar.

productTileImage.$description: v2 product card image well height (was 110). Image is BoxFit.contain on surface.imageWell, 8 dp inset.

productGridMaxExtent.$description: Two columns on 360-412 dp phones. Grows to 200 x textScale at >= 1.5x so the grid becomes one column (CA-14).

subCategoryRail.$description: Replaced by a horizontal chip row at >= 1.5x text (CA-14).

trackingMap.$description: Placed after the OTP and COD cards (CA-25).

ctaButton.$description: Height of FilledButton / ElevatedButton (the gold main CTA).

addButton.$description: ADD button and QuantityBox height on product cards (full card width).

searchField.$description: Home search field on the header band.

navBar.$description: NavigationBar height (icon 24, indicator 56 x 32, label 12 sp).

offerStrip.$description: Minimum height of the welcome / referral strip on Home.

bannerViewport.$description: PageController.viewportFraction: the next banner peeks 8% so customers see they can swipe.

font.$description: Roboto (the system font: no download, good Devanagari fallback) until the brand kit names a font (TODO(D-06)). v2 gets its personality from weight (700-800) and size, not from a new font. No hard-coded sizes in widgets: everything comes from the text theme and scales. Minimum for information is 12 sp; 11 sp only for badges that repeat information shown elsewhere.

tileVariant.$description: v1 only. v2 cards show the pack size as a pill (packSizePill).

tilePrice.$description: titleLarge w800 (v2). The server price, one line, FittedBox scaleDown.

tileMrp.$description: bodySmall, text.secondary, line-through; screen reader says 'MRP ₹X'.

discountBadge.$description: labelSmall w700; the same percentage is also in the price semantics.

blockerReason.$description: Proposed (CA-20): up from bodySmall 12 sp, with an info icon.

statusHeadline.$description: headlineSmall w700 on order detail and tracking.

deliveryOtp.$description: displaySmall; screen reader reads the digits one by one.

homeHeadline.$description: 'Delivery in 14 min' on the header band (headlineSmall w800, white).

appBarTitle.$description: Inner-screen app bar title (white on brand.primaryDeep).

ctaLabel.$description: FilledButton / ElevatedButton label, ADD label (labelLarge override).

typeScale.$description: The Material 3 TextTheme for jivo_core (v2). Line heights are Material defaults. Colours come from the scheme (onSurface) unless a component says otherwise.

productAspect.$description: Product and category images; export 1000x1000 px, product centred on white or transparent (catalog-data). Shown with BoxFit.contain.

bannerAspect.$description: Proposed (CA-15): home banners in an AspectRatio(2) box with BoxFit.cover; export 1200x600 px, keep text inside the middle 80%.

decodeAtLayoutSize.$description: Image.network decode size (CA-15), so budget phones never decode full-size photos for 56-150 dp tiles.

placeholder.$value: surface.highest box, radius.sm, 32 dp icon in text.secondary
placeholder.$description: Missing URL, loading or load error (ProductImage).

bannerAdvance.$description: 0 = off. v2 banners are static and swiped by hand (home-v2.md §4).

successPop.$description: Order-placed icon. Proposed: skip it under reduced motion (CA-23).

pendingSpinnerDelay.$description: Proposed (CA-17): a cart change in flight longer than this shows a spinner in the stepper.

trackPoll.$description: track/ polling while the order socket is down.

ticketPoll.$description: Proposed (CA-30): open ticket thread refresh while not CLOSED.

etaLateAfter.$description: Proposed (CA-26): 5 min past the server ETA switches 'Arriving any moment' to the late copy.

press.$description: Cards and ADD scale to 0.97 while pressed. Skipped when MediaQuery.disableAnimations is on.

qtySwap.$description: ADD -> QuantityBox cross-fade (AnimatedSwitcher, fade + scale 0.9 -> 1). Skipped when MediaQuery.disableAnimations is on.

cartBarEnter.$description: Cart bar slides up from below the nav bar the first time an item is added. Skipped when MediaQuery.disableAnimations is on.

curve.$description: Curves.easeOutCubic for every v2 motion. No springs, no parallax, no shimmer.

stackRowsFrom.$description: From this scale, label/value rows that hold two variable texts (status chip + date, cart line info + stepper, address label + chips) stack or wrap (CA-08, CA-18, CA-24).

singleColumnFrom.$description: Product grid one column, sub-category rail becomes chips, checkout bars stack the total above the button (CA-14, CA-20).

contrast.$description: WCAG 2.x contrast ratios, computed exactly from the hex values above. Text needs 4.5:1 (3:1 only for 18 sp+, or 14 sp bold and larger); icons and borders that carry meaning need 3:1. 'Where' names the main uses in customer_app/lib.

rejected.reason: Fails AA text. Out-of-stock tiles: variant, MRP and the 'Out of stock' label itself (product_tile.dart:102-103). Replaced by full-opacity text and the stock.out pill (CA-11).
On white cards this now clears 4.5:1 by only 0.03, and fails on any tinted surface. Still not allowed: out-of-stock product names stay at full opacity (CA-11).
Fails AA text. 'Only N left' inside a dimmed tile (CA-11).
Fails 3:1 for meaningful icons. 'Upcoming' timeline icons and connector (order_timeline.dart:42). Use outline.default, 4.24:1 (CA-29).
Allowed for disabled controls only (WCAG exempts inactive components). Read-only rating stars must not use it (CA-34).

rejected.pair: accent.gold #FFC83D as text or icon on surface.card
rejected.reason: Gold is a fill, never a foreground on white or ivory. Use accent.goldEdge #9E6A00 (4.65:1) for gold-ish text or icons on light surfaces.
White labels on gold fail. Every label on gold uses accent.onGold #3B2600 (9.28:1).
Green text on gold fails 4.5:1. The ADD label is ink, not green.
Misses 4.5:1 by 0.01. Allowed only as an icon (nav indicator); labels stay on white.

contrast.notes: v2 (2026-11-14): every pair in use passes AA; the rejected list says which combinations widgets must not use. Gradients are checked at both stops (header: white is 8.10 and 5.40; offer: ink is 11.94 and 8.94). When the brand kit arrives (H-19, D-06), recompute every 'placeholder' value and every pair, then run python -I design/tools/check_tokens.py.
